text:
Catalytic converters in car exhausts change polluting gases into non-polluting gases.
Which statements about oxides of nitrogen and car engines are correct?
1
The nitrogen in oxides of nitrogen comes from compounds in gasoline.
2
The oxygen in oxides of nitrogen comes from the air in the car engine.
3
Catalytic converters convert oxides of nitrogen into nitrogen.
A
1 and 2
B
2 and 3
C
2 only
D
3 only
subject: Chemistry
